dreamteamer.title: Responsibilities
dreamteamer.description: `responsibilities`: an area of ownership — release sign-off, the relationship with a client, the CI pipeline, onboarding — one record per area, and an overlay of `users` adding `responsibilities`, so "who owns X" is one read and each area lists who carries it. Not a task and not a role. Depends on `users`.
